[image: Abolishing ICE: A Call for Reform illustration] Abolishing ICE: A Call for Reform Lydia will work to abolish ICE and replace it with a fair, compassionate immigration system that upholds human dignity, stops constitutional violations, and ensures equal protection for all. Read More

[image: Ending Concentration Camps and Protecting Human Rights illustration] Ending Concentration Camps and Protecting Human Rights ICE detention has passed 60,000 people while the agency cut its own inspection schedule and stripped minimum pay for detainee labor, forced labor the Constitution's narrow exception, which only covers convicted criminals, never actually permitted. Lydia will push to require minimum wage for detainee work, restore mandatory inspections, stop federal facility purchases designed to dodge state oversight, and fully fund independent Inspector General review. Read More

[image: Fighting Mass Surveillance and Technofeudalism: A Bill of Digital Rights illustration] Fighting Mass Surveillance and Technofeudalism: A Bill of Digital Rights Lydia will fight warrantless surveillance of Americans' communications, dismantle the license plate reader dragnet, and introduce a Bill of Digital Rights making your data your property. Read More

[image: Keeping ICE and Federal Agents Out of Polling Places illustration] Keeping ICE and Federal Agents Out of Polling Places Federal agents have already entered polling places in 2026, and even DHS and ICE leadership say they have no reason to be there. Lydia will close the legal gap that lets civilian federal law enforcement operate at polling places, oppose federal funding for it, and make voter intimidation by any federal agent explicit grounds for liability. Read More

[image: Repealing the Patriot Act: Defending Civil Liberties illustration] Repealing the Patriot Act: Defending Civil Liberties Most of the Patriot Act's surveillance powers already expired in 2020. Two provisions are still active: sneak-and-peek warrants that delay notifying you of a search, and National Security Letters that compel your records without a judge's approval. Lydia will push to end both. Read More
